gaps.explanation: p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds prints Water Fund and Sewer Fund columns; no business-type schedule lines in detail[]. JSON receipts = Sales + Other revenue + Interest income + Grant income. Water: Sales 132,880 + Other revenue 4,978 + Interest income 25 = 137,883; Sewer: Sales 89,632 + Interest income 532 + Grant income 58,583 = 148,747; 137,883 + 148,747 = 286,630 = statement total. No transfers or other financing rows printed.
